name: Thornsnarl
summary: Thornsnarl is a tangled, hostile encampment in southern Mulgore near Camp Narache. Bristleback quilboar have aggressively encroached into these hills, capturing young tauren and threatening the ancestral homeland.

sections.title: A Bristleback Incursion
sections.body: Located in southern Mulgore just outside the Red Cloud Mesa, Thornsnarl serves as a violent foothold for Bristleback quilboar pushing westward into tauren territory. These aggressive invaders, accompanied by battleboars and thorncallers, actively seek to claim fresh pastures from the tribes. The site has become a frontline of early skirmishes, where young fledgling braves are deployed to defend their borders and rescue captive kin dragged away by the quilboar raiders.

faq.answer: Thornsnarl is a quilboar-infested area in southern Mulgore, situated near Camp Narache and Red Cloud Mesa, where Bristleback invaders have established an entrenched position.

faq.q: Why are the quilboar attacking here?
faq.answer: The Bristleback tribe has spilled over into southern Mulgore seeking to claim new land, hunting grounds, and resources away from the settled tauren tribes.

faq.q: Who are the captured braves inside Thornsnarl?
faq.answer: They are young tauren braves captured by the Bristleback invaders during border skirmishes, held within the northern reaches of the encampment until rescued by their kin.

angles.text: For young tauren coming of age at Red Cloud Mesa, clearing Thornsnarl and rescuing captured kin is a crucial trial to protect their nascent homeland.
The entrenched Bristlebacks at Thornsnarl represent an ongoing security hazard to Mulgore's interior border.
